title: Complete standalone v6.1 rendering input and evidenced execution validation

SafeId.description: 用于DOM属性和CSS属性选择器的ASCII标识。命名空间唯一性与原型保留名由语义校验负责。

HexColor.description: 当前renderer会拼接08作为alpha，故只接受6位hex颜色。

Actor.description: 横向参与者。children 可递归；color 为当前 renderer 使用的 CSS 颜色。后五个可选参数来自上游布局；当前 app 显式传展开集合，defaultExpanded 不决定初始展开。className/regionClassName 未用于当前 DOM 样式。

Message.description: 消息对象。pair=null 表示不参与调用配对。taskId/handleId/wrapperId/pairState 用于点击后的信息。completion/taskEvent/attemptId/resultId 为现有 fixture 保留的数据，当前 renderer 不用它们决定绘图。上游读取 rowIndex，当前 app 的垂直顺序仍取控制节点 messages 顺序。

mergeReason.description: For a multi-action goal, the stated merge reason may be recorded here or as cohesionReason in the matching stage-2 goal contract.

splitReason.description: Required here for each goal in a split identified by matching adjacent stage-2 completion contracts and entry modes; no other field substitutes for it.

label.description: Source-evidenced display name copied from stage4; avoids exposing internal decision IDs/outcome enums as titles.
